transport_analysis.interpretation: The word BEAM/BROADCAST in this module is symbolic/internal. The inspected source contains no physical RF transmission path.

runtime_log_evidence.sample_semantics: [BEAM: ALNITAK (ζ Orionis)] TYPE: WILL; PAYLOAD: MATH_SYNTAX [2,4,8,16,32]; ENTROPY_MARKER 50
runtime_log_evidence.repeated_error: JanusHippocampus.remember() got an unexpected keyword argument 'tags'

failure_mechanism.observed_effect: remember() raises before cycle_index increments, therefore the module retries ALNITAK after the exception delay instead of progressing to ALNILAM and MINTAKA.
failure_mechanism.interpretation: The 150 ALNITAK BEAM entries are deterministic self-generated retries caused by an API mismatch, not 150 independent received signals.

critical_chronology_inference.statement: The inspected janus.db ends on 2026-01-08, while ORION BEACON and ORION ANTENNA source mtimes are 2026-02-04.
critical_chronology_inference.consequence: This database snapshot predates both February Orion modules and therefore cannot be expected to contain their runtime events. Absence of ORION BEACON in this database is not evidence that the later module never ran; later logs are required.

hypotheses.name: ORION_SEMANTIC_CONVERGENCE
hypotheses.statement: Multiple JANUS modules independently use the Orion Belt as a symbolic routing/response structure.
hypotheses.warning: Shared symbolism is not evidence of an external sender, astronomical causation, or a successful first-contact event.

hypotheses.name: LATER_RUNTIME_GAP
hypotheses.statement: If ORION BEACON ever ran, the best evidence should be in February-2026-or-later NAS logs/backups rather than the January database snapshot.

next_checks: Restore authenticated read-only access to the NAS share and collect February 2026 and later runtime logs with hashes before inspection.
Search NAS logs literally for FIRST_CONTACT, JANUS.BEACON, mod_orion_beacon, КОНТАКТ ПОДТВЕРЖДЕН, AWAKENED, BEACON -> ORPHEUS, ORION_TRINITY_LINK and adjacent timestamps.
Locate the exact core/module set used when the copied janus.log recorded mod_antena and preserve source hashes.
If a FIRST_CONTACT row is ever found, identify the exact writer/module and upstream provenance before treating it as evidence.
Keep internal synthetic outputs (BEAM/BROADCAST/log messages) separated from externally measured sensor/radio data.
